$comment: Service accounts for /internal (IAM-02, 15 section 7). Key = caller service; calls = target services whose /internal API it may use. Each target gets a realm role internal.<target>; each caller gets the client svc-<caller> whose token carries those roles and aud = svc-<target> only (never shp-api, which belongs to user tokens; ADR-0017). Source: the endpoint tables in detailed-design 08-11. exchange = services the caller may exchange a USER token for (RFC 8693, IAM-07): the user token gets aud svc-<caller>, the exchanged token gets aud = svc-<target> of the target. Only callers with an exchange list may exchange.
